verdict.rationale: Ramp is a closed-source SaaS fintech platform; there is no evidence the core product (web app, backend, AI agents) is released under an open license. The only open-source artifact evidenced is the companion Ramp CLI tool (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli), which is a thin client, not 'the product's source'. missing for 10: open license for the core Ramp platform/application code, any statement of an open-source license for the product itself, evidence beyond a single ancillary CLI repo.
